title: Frontend: Oranges Rotting
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Oranges Rotting. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(grid). 0 is empty, 1 fresh, 2 a spreading source. Orthogonal spread occurs simultaneously each minute. Return minutes to activate all fresh cells or -1 if impossible; no fresh cells returns 0. Preserve input.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Start a multi-source BFS with every initially active source and count remaining susceptible cells.
alternativeApproaches: Return the activation time of every cell and preserve the original grid by storing visitation separately.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: No fresh cells; no sources; isolated cell.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
